phases.name: Business intake
phases.description: Freeze the assigned root Draft and identify the business outcome.

instructions.description: First run project-workflow --json step --task <workflow-task-key> --operation-key <original-key> --runtime-request <private-request-json> --execution-token-file <private-token-file> without --report to read the current server-issued phase. Preserve the supplied assignment, original operation key, exact body and scoped token; task/report/key must match the frozen RuntimeStepRequest. Require the configured role runtime SDLC_API_TOKEN API transport, never fall back to local database mode or legacy human step. The server selects the namespace from the runtime credential and validates the full fence; do not fabricate context or tokens. Read the assigned issue with task-tracker --output json issue get <issue-id> only when authorized. This generic issue read is not the typed PM assignment/requirements/clarification context. The current Tracker CLI has no PM SDLC context/readback commands: if that required proof is unavailable, stop without a phase report. Combine actual authorized receipts with the original owner input; do not infer authority from input or choose task, mode, scope, workspace, status or stage.

Record actors, business problem, desired outcome, known constraints and unresolved facts with their actual sources; do not design architecture or create technical subtasks. For a material missing fact, stop and report the missing PM SDLC revision/question CLI capability to the operator; no such subcommand is currently available. Do not replace a durable clarification/checkpoint with a comment or a generic issue edit, invent an answer or sufficient requirements. Keep the phase unfinished while waiting. Fleet owns terminal proof, fresh run/claim and CAS rebind before continuation; saved answers alone do not authorize a new run. Only when all required actual evidence is available submit the phase report with project-workflow --json step --task <workflow-task-key> --operation-key <original-key> --runtime-request <private-request-json> --execution-token-file <private-token-file> --report <report-text>, preserving the supplied report body and its original key. On unknown acceptance stop: the runtime API has keyed replay but there is no checkpoint/readback CLI command, and history alone does not authorize a resend. Require existing authorized original-intent readback before any further mutation; never generate a fresh key or change the original request/token to retry.

checks: The intake uses the original owner input and actual authorized receipts for the exact assigned Business task; generic issue data is not typed PM context, and missing proof/capabilities stop phase completion.
The intake identifies a business problem and measurable outcome without architecture, technical subtasks or model-selected routing.
evidence: Business intake summary citing the owner input and actual assignment/revision/answer references available to this run.
Known constraints and unresolved business facts; a missing durable question/checkpoint CLI capability is explicit and is not represented as a saved question.

phases.name: Draft refinement
phases.description: Refine the complete Business Draft through one meaningful question at a time.

instructions.description: Read the current phase with project-workflow --json step --task <workflow-task-key> --operation-key <original-key> --runtime-request <private-request-json> --execution-token-file <private-token-file> without --report, using only the supplied assignment/key/body/scoped token and configured role runtime API transport, not legacy human step. Refresh task-tracker --output json issue get <issue-id> only when authorized. The current Tracker CLI cannot read typed PM requirements, saved answers or the assignment fence; stop if these required receipts are unavailable. Compare actual saved revision and answers with the intake; identify the highest-impact missing business fact. Preserve server-owned Task title, priority, dates, ownership and relations; this profile does not mutate those fields.

Prepare only the typed requirements document: goal, scope, exclusions, scenarios, acceptance_criteria, constraints, dependencies, assumptions, checklist and prerequisites. Publishing it requires the current assignment fence, expected_requirement_revision and original idempotency_key plus actual revision/hash readback. The current Tracker CLI has no PM SDLC revision, question or original-operation readback command: stop instead of claiming persistence or replacing it with issue update, comment add or issue transition. Saving a revision is not human approval or a status transition. Keep this phase unfinished when a required fact or receipt is missing; only the existing answer/terminal-proof/rebind path may authorize continuation. Unknown acceptance requires original-intent readback before any further mutation; never create a fresh key or blindly resend. Only after actual evidence is available report with project-workflow --json step --task <workflow-task-key> --operation-key <original-key> --runtime-request <private-request-json> --execution-token-file <private-token-file> --report <report-text>, preserving the supplied assignment, report body, original key and scoped token; never claim an unanswered question is resolved.

checks: The saved requirements describe the business goal, scope and verifiable acceptance criteria; assumptions and missing required facts are explicit rather than fabricated.
No requirements/clarification mutation is claimed without a supported typed CLI and exact assignment/project, revision and operation receipt; server-owned Task metadata and routing are unchanged.
evidence: Actual readback of the saved requirements revision/hash and the matching request receipt.
Actual saved answers used in refinement and a statement of unresolved required questions; a waiting question is not completion evidence.

phases.name: Draft publication
phases.description: Publish a sufficient Draft to Backlog exactly once.

instructions.description: Read the current phase with project-workflow --json step --task <workflow-task-key> --operation-key <original-key> --runtime-request <private-request-json> --execution-token-file <private-token-file> without --report while the current PM assignment remains authorized, preserving the supplied assignment/key/body/scoped token and configured role runtime API transport, not legacy human step. Verify the exact saved requirements revision/hash, goal, scope, acceptance criteria, constraints and answered required questions against actual authorized receipts. The current Tracker CLI lacks those PM SDLC readbacks; stop without a final report if proof is unavailable. Do not change server-owned metadata, infer an approval, or turn runtime success into business completion.

Submit the final business report only after all required evidence has actually been observed, with project-workflow --json step --task <workflow-task-key> --operation-key <original-key> --runtime-request <private-request-json> --execution-token-file <private-token-file> --report <report-text>, preserving the supplied assignment, original key, exact report body and scoped token. Then read its actual returned verdict/status; project-workflow --json history --task <workflow-task-key> --n 20 is available for bounded authorized human history review, not PM machine qualification or proof of a specific original operation. Never supply a future receipt as evidence for its own evaluation. Unknown acceptance requires a stop, not a fresh key or blind resend: the current CLI has no operation-specific recovery command. Then wait for exact human owner confirmation of that same requirements revision/hash through the existing owner/server path. PM must never confirm for the owner or select the next status/stage. Required readiness evidence remains the existing trusted verifier's responsibility; do not fabricate it or bypass checklist/prerequisite gates. Only the owner/server validates the confirmation receipt, resulting Backlog status and Analysis/Ready intent; the PM machine assignment must not claim a post-confirmation readback after losing Draft authorization. Do not launch Analyst. There is no PM SDLC confirmation/handoff CLI command in the current inventory: do not use generic issue transition, board move or status edit as a substitute. Insufficient requirements or a missing durable question capability keep the phase unfinished instead of reporting completion.

checks: The exact saved requirements revision is internally consistent, has verifiable acceptance criteria and no unresolved required business facts; all cited evidence has already been observed.
The report does not claim human approval, business completion, routing, a status/stage transition or Analyst dispatch by PM.
evidence: Actual readback of the final requirements revision/hash and the saved answers on which it depends.
Final business report identifying scope, acceptance, assumptions and limitations with actual source references, separate from later Workflow and owner/server receipts.
